clue.text: Fine book Gradgrind believed in

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for fine, as on pencil grades
Acts of the Apostles is a book of the Bible

explanation.surface: A fine volume that Dickens's schoolmaster swore by.
explanation.walkthrough: Thomas Gradgrind, in Dickens's Hard Times, opens the novel demanding nothing but plain truths.
explanation.definitionFit: Gradgrind's creed is that only hard data and verified realities matter.

clue.text: Iris oversees the servants — one must keep up standards

indicators.note: in a down clue, sitting over another piece means coming before it

parts.note: flag is a name for the iris plant
staff are the servants or employees

explanation.surface: A flower supervises the household servants, one of whom maintains standards.
explanation.walkthrough: A standard is a flag, so the pole that holds it up keeps up standards.
explanation.definitionFit: A standard is a banner, and the pole that bears it literally holds such banners up.

clue.text: Group who can all spell

parts.note: suggests a literate class but spell means cast magic, so it is a gathering of witches

explanation.surface: A class of people who are all good at spelling.
explanation.definitionFit: A gathering of witches, each able to work magic charms, is a coven by name.

clue.text: Sinner had to come to the highest court in Jerusalem

indicators.note: the letters come round into a new shape, as one comes to after fainting

explanation.surface: A sinner had to appear before the supreme tribunal in Jerusalem.
explanation.definitionFit: The Sanhedrin was the supreme Jewish council and tribunal of ancient Jerusalem.

clue.text: Dress adjustment that may produce an engagement

definitions.text: Dress adjustment that may produce an engagement

parts.words: Dress adjustment that may produce an engagement
parts.note: reads as altering clothes to win a fiancé, but gear can be dress and the shift of gear makes cogs engage

explanation.surface: Changing one's outfit could lead to a marriage proposal.
explanation.definitionFit: Moving a car's lever changes which cogs mesh, so a new ratio engages.

clue.text: Impressive degree for member of the family

parts.note: grand means impressive or magnificent
MA is a Master of Arts degree

explanation.surface: Someone in the family earns an impressive qualification.
explanation.definitionFit: A grandmother is a relative, a parent's mother.

clue.text: A row about the Spanish in the workshop

indicators.note: the word for a row goes about, surrounding, the Spanish article

parts.note: a tier is a row, as of seats
el is Spanish for 'the'

explanation.surface: A dispute over the Spanish workers in the factory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'row' reads as a quarrel but means a tier of seats.
explanation.definitionFit: An atelier is an artist's or designer's studio.

clue.text: It's foolish to get very near a striker

definitions.meaning: in cricket, ... describes a fielding position very close to the batsman, as ... mid-on

explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the batsman is the striker, and fielders called silly stand right beside him.
explanation.definitionFit: It means daft, and in cricket it labels fielding spots placed dangerously close to the batsman.

clue.text: Execute agent

definitions.meaning: to execute is to carry out or put into effect
an agent is a means or tool by which something is done

explanation.definitionFit: To carry out a plan is to put it into effect, and a tool is an agent of work.

clue.text: Bulb found in this sort of wood

definitions.meaning: a bulb is a flowering plant grown from a bulb
tulipwood is a kind of timber

explanation.definitionFit: It is a spring flower grown from a bulb, and also names a timber, tulipwood.

clue.text: Edge in or out of court

definitions.meaning: an edge is a superior position over a rival
the tennis score after deuce, called 'in' for the server and 'out' for the receiver

explanation.walkthrough: In tennis, after deuce the umpire calls the score 'in' or 'out' according to which player has the point.
explanation.definitionFit: Having the edge means holding a favourable lead, and the tennis call names the point won after deuce.

clue.text: Small turnover common in the garment industry

definitions.text: Small turnover common in the garment industry

parts.words: Small turnover common in the garment industry
parts.note: sounds like modest sales figures in the rag trade, but a turnover here is a folded-back strip of cloth found on jackets

explanation.surface: Clothing manufacturers often see low sales.
explanation.definitionFit: The folded-back front flap of a jacket collar is a small turned-over piece of fabric.

clue.text: Discrimination in faculty

definitions.meaning: discrimination as good judgement or discernment
one of sight, hearing, touch, taste or smell

explanation.definitionFit: Good judgement is called good taste or wit, and each bodily power of perception is also named so.

clue.text: Cleaner newspaper deserves support

parts.note: a daily is a newspaper published every day
help means support or assistance

explanation.surface: A newspaper that cleans up its act deserves our backing.
explanation.walkthrough: A daily help is the British term for a cleaner who comes in by the day.
explanation.definitionFit: A domestic worker who comes in to tidy a house is a cleaner.

clue.text: Sort of great hall a province needed

parts.note: the Albert Hall is a great concert hall in London

explanation.surface: A province needed some kind of grand meeting hall.
explanation.walkthrough: The Royal Albert Hall is London's famous domed concert venue.
explanation.definitionFit: Alberta is one of Canada's western provinces.

clue.text: Bright idea for Red Indian housing in Washington

indicators.note: the warrior word holds the other letters inside it

parts.note: a brave is a Native American warrior
taken as written
WA is the postal abbreviation for Washington state

explanation.surface: A clever idea to house Native Americans in Washington.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden clever inspiration is a flash of genius.

clue.text: Tyre not needed for Lucy's ways?

definitions.text: Tyre not needed for Lucy's ways?

parts.words: Tyre not needed for Lucy's ways?
parts.note: Wordsworth's Lucy 'dwelt among the untrodden ways', so the ways were never trodden again

explanation.surface: No tyre is required on the paths Lucy walks.
explanation.walkthrough: Wordsworth's Lucy poem begins 'She dwelt among the untrodden ways'; ways not trodden again are not re-trod.
explanation.definitionFit: A tyre given a new tread is a recapped one, the word punning on 'trodden again'.

clue.text: Marine in small ship left Ithaca in a storm

indicators.note: a storm tosses the letters into a new order

parts.note: SS, steamship, is a ship written small as an abbreviation

explanation.surface: A marine in a little ship left Ithaca in rough weather.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in a storm' rearranges SS, L and ITHACA.
explanation.definitionFit: Thalassic means relating to the sea, from Greek thalassa.

clue.text: Daughter moving round the underground before coming out?

indicators.note: turning round signals that the word for the underground is read backwards

parts.note: the Tube is the London Underground
ante is Latin for before

explanation.surface: A daughter travels round the Tube before her society début.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moving round' reverses the Tube, London's underground railway. A debutante is a young woman 'coming out' into society, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: A young woman formally introduced to society is said to come out.

clue.text: Fabric requiring soft soap

definitions.meaning: soft soap is flattery or evasive smooth talk

explanation.definitionFit: It is a woven woollen cloth, and in British slang it also means flattering or evasive talk.

clue.text: Song in the officers' lines

indicators.note: the song goes inside the officers' letters

parts.note: Lts are lieutenants, officers
an aria is an operatic song

explanation.surface: A song sung in the officers' quarters.
explanation.definitionFit: Lariats are ropes, and lines are ropes or cords.

clue.text: Carton of food suitable for a dip

definitions.text: Carton of food suitable for a dip

parts.words: Carton of food suitable for a dip
parts.note: sounds like a pot of snacks for dipping, but it is a tub of cereal husks used for a lucky dip

explanation.surface: A tub of nibbles fit for dipping into.
explanation.walkthrough: A lucky dip is a British fair game where children rummage in a tub of bran for buried prizes.
explanation.definitionFit: At British fêtes, prizes are buried in a tub of husks and fished out in a lucky dip.

clue.text: Skipper who repeatedly told the truth

definitions.text: Skipper who repeatedly told the truth

parts.words: Skipper who repeatedly told the truth
parts.note: Lewis Carroll's captain in The Hunting of the Snark declares 'What I tell you three times is true'

explanation.surface: A captain who kept on telling the truth.
explanation.walkthrough: In Carroll's The Hunting of the Snark, the ship's captain insists that whatever he says three times is true.
explanation.definitionFit: Carroll's Snark-hunting captain held that saying something three times made it true.

clue.text: Girl entering the waterway to the Cape

indicators.note: the girl's name goes into the word for the waterway

parts.note: a canal is a man-made waterway
Vera is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl takes the canal down to the headland.
explanation.definitionFit: Cape Canaveral is the Florida headland from which rockets launch.

clue.text: Islamic ruler lying in state

definitions.meaning: a caliph, here spelt with F, is a Muslim ruler
The abbreviation for the US state California

explanation.definitionFit: It is a variant spelling of caliph, a Muslim sovereign, and an abbreviation for California.

clue.text: Individual in motor boat upset out of malice

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset means turned upside down, so read upwards
the individual goes inside the boat's letters

parts.note: MV is motor vessel
one is a single individual

explanation.surface: A lone person in a capsized motor boat, out of spite.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'upset' reads the boat with its passenger from the bottom up.
explanation.definitionFit: Venom is bitter spite or ill will.

clue.text: To protect the king, a subaltern is on guard

indicators.note: the officer's letters surround and so guard the royal letters

parts.note: a subaltern is a junior officer such as a lieutenant, abbreviated Lt
ER stands for Edwardus Rex, King Edward

explanation.surface: A junior officer stands on guard to protect the monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'To protect' has the officer surround the monarch; ER is Edward Rex, more often used for the Queen.
explanation.definitionFit: Being watchful and ready for danger is being vigilant.

clue.text: News reel item featuring the top people

indicators.note: the words feature the answer within their run of letters

explanation.surface: A newsreel item showing the great and good.
explanation.definitionFit: The best or most select group of a society are the upper crust.

clue.text: Acquire knowledge about renal failure

indicators.note: the breakdown of the word renal signals its letters being rearranged

explanation.surface: Finding out about kidney disease.
explanation.definitionFit: To gain knowledge is to study and pick it up.

clue.text: Access to a profession

definitions.meaning: access means entry or the right to get in
a profession here is a declaration or confession of something

explanation.definitionFit: Entry granted is the right to come in, and a confession of fault is owning up.

clue.text: Brother, mother and boy not subject to tax at first

indicators.note: places the tax-exempt word at the front before the mother and boy

parts.note: free can mean exempt, as in duty-free
ma is a familiar word for mother
a son is a boy

explanation.surface: A family of brother, mother and son enjoying a tax-free start.
explanation.walkthrough: Members of the Masonic order address each other as Brother.
explanation.definitionFit: Lodge members of the Masonic fraternity call each other by this sibling title.

clue.text: Note first sign of porosity in church fabric

indicators.note: the note and letter go inside the abbreviation for church

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
re is the second note of the sol-fa scale

indicators.note: the opening letter of porosity is taken

explanation.surface: Note the first hint of porous material in the church's cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a thin crinkled cloth, a type of textile.
